notablePrerequisites: You control an additional blue or black creature.
description:
Cast Cavern Harpy by tapping Fallaji Wayfarer and a blue or black creature.
Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Cavern Harpy trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
